title: Розгляд пропозиції та рішення
fields_and_relations: До/після, base revision, докази, scope, decision/reason і конкретний результат.
required_interaction: Accept/reject/correct/defer; stale base блокує apply; автор пропозиції не отримує reviewer grant.

implementation.view_model: Source/proposal comparison, human accept/correct/reject/defer with evidence, immutable decision history and atomic application
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v8; v1–7 migration preserves existing records, revoked grants and demo walkthroughs
permissions: Separate scoped review.write, publication.write and access.manage grants
Applying description changes also requires catalog.write
Navigation and demo account choice do not change permission assignments
implementation.atomicity: Review, exact result revision, evidence, verification and application commit together. Deferred review retains a task. Source changes invalidate linked effective policies and withdraw affected publications. Revocation withdraws linked publications in the same transaction.
limitations: Local browser prototype only; no real publication server or network transport.

Review application supports title/description of information units, documents and physical objects; identity matches retain their dedicated source workflow. No generic classification or relation application.
Existing decisions can be inspected/revoked; consent lifecycle, new access grants and rights renewal after source edits remain pending.
New publication preparation covers public metadata; configuring new media release permissions, translations and deposit transport remains pending.
Existing historical publications may be visible but require a separate exact-source verification before republishing.
